description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for in-memory webhook rate limiting, counters, and anomaly tracking, including fixed window rate limiter and bounded counters.

methods.name: createFixedWindowRateLimiter
methods.description: Creates a fixed-window rate limiter for in-memory webhook protection.

methods.name: createBoundedCounter
methods.description: Creates a keyed event counter with optional TTL and size limits.

methods.name: createWebhookAnomalyTracker
methods.description: Creates a tracker for repeated webhook failures with sampling and logging.
